Quotes are USD per GPU-hour, excluding storage, taxes and ancillary charges. *The 24-hour estimate is the hourly quote × 24, not a daily discount. These are hardware prices, not language-model inference prices.

Stock is an observation, not a reservation. Unsupported cloud entries are identified separately. Daily averages are sample means, not time-weighted charges. Lines connect recorded samples; missing hours are not backfilled. One point is not a trend. Refreshing this page does not collect a new provider quote.

Hourly collection depends on the scheduled collector and its connected sources. The page shows its latest successful observation and flags stale data. Downloaded CSV files are the published snapshot; the raw-history link points to the current repository record.
